text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收看《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收看《Real Easy English》。

text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English
zh: 我们用简单英语进行真实对话的播客
zh_hant: 我們用簡單英語進行真實對話的播客

text: to help you learn.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video version of this podcast
zh: 你可以找到这个播客的视频版本
zh_hant: 你可以找到這個播客的影片版本

text: and a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
zh: 我们网站上还有一份学习工作表可以帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們網站上還有一份學習工作表可以幫助你學習。

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Beth?
I'm OK, Neil.
I'm a little bit tired.
How are you?
I'm very well.
I'm fine.
Great.
Good, good.
Well, today we're going to talk about mistakes .
So hopefully I won't make many mistakes , being tired.
zh: 希望我累的时候不会犯太多错误。
zh_hant: 希望我累的時候不會犯太多錯誤。

text: No. Yes.
That's true.
So I think let's start the conversation.
Let's do it.
So, Beth, have you made any mistakes recently?
zh: 贝丝,你最近犯过什么错误吗?
zh_hant: 貝絲,你最近犯過什麼錯誤嗎?

text: Yes.
So I recently left my suitcase on a train by mistake
zh: 我最近不小心把手提箱落在火车上了
zh_hant: 我最近不小心把手提箱落在火車上了

text: Oh, no.
So I
was travelling
from home to Leeds on the train.
And I got to the station at Leeds,
and there were loads of people,
and they were, they were football fans and they were singing really loudly.
zh: 他们是足球迷,唱得特别大声。
zh_hant: 他們是足球迷,唱得特別大聲。

text: And I just wanted to get off the train.
And that's what I did.
And then I realised about half an hour later
zh: 然后大约半个小时后我才意识到
zh_hant: 然後大約半個小時後我才意識到

text: that I didn't have my suitcase.
Oh no.
So...
That's a bad mistake .
Did you get it back?
I did, I was so lucky.
The train stopped at Leeds.
So when I realised I ran and said
zh: 我意识到后就跑过去说
zh_hant: 我意識到後就跑過去說

text: to the people on the platform,
"My suitcase is on the train!"
And they held the train for me and I ran up the platform.
zh: 他们为我留了车,我沿着站台跑了过去。
zh_hant: 他們為我留了車,我沿著站臺跑了過去。

text: I grabbed my suitcase
and then they blew the whistle and the train went.
zh: 然后他们吹响了哨子,火车就开动了。
zh_hant: 然後他們吹響了哨子,火車就開動了。

text: I was so lucky.
But yeah, that was a big mistake .
zh: 不过没错,那是个大错误。
zh_hant: 不過沒錯,那是個大錯誤。

text: And I will not make that mistake again.
zh: 我不会再犯那个错误了。
zh_hant: 我不會再犯那個錯誤了。

text: Everybody says that.
So earlier we said
that mistakes can be small things,
like my suitcase.
But there are big mistakes that we can make.
zh: 但我们也可能犯一些大错误。
zh_hant: 但我們也可能犯一些大錯誤。

text: So have you ever made a big mistake , do you think?
zh: 你觉得你有没有犯过什么大错误?
zh_hant: 你覺得你有沒有犯過什麼大錯誤?

text: Yeah.
Well, once I had a job that I really, really enjoyed,
zh: 我曾经有过一份我非常非常喜欢的工作,
zh_hant: 我曾經有過一份我非常非常喜歡的工作,

text: I was teaching at a school in Prague,
zh: 我当时在布拉格的一所学校教书。
zh_hant: 我當時在布拉格的一所學校教書。

text: in the Czech Republic, teaching English,
and I loved the job and I had loads of really good friends.
zh: 我很喜欢那份工作,还交了很多真心好朋友。
zh_hant: 我很喜歡那份工作,還交了很多真心好朋友。

text: But I had this feeling
that I needed to go move somewhere else,
zh: 我需要搬到别的地方去
zh_hant: 我需要搬到別的地方去

text: do something else with my life.
zh: 用我的人生去做点别的事
zh_hant: 用我的人生去做點別的事

text: And so I resigned.
But then about a week or so later,
I realised that I really, really didn't want to leave
zh: 我意识到我真的非常不想离开
zh_hant: 我意識到我真的非常不想離開

text: that school.
So I went back
to the boss and I said, "I've changed my mind.
zh: 我跟老板说:"我改变主意了。
zh_hant: 我跟老闆說:"我改變主意了。

text: I want to stay".
And he said, "Well,
it's too late because I've given your job to somebody else".
zh: 太晚了,因为我已经把你的工作给别人了。
zh_hant: 太晚了,因為我已經把你的工作給別人了。

text: Oh, no, that's so sad.
So you left your job?
Left Prague?
No, actually, a bit like your suitcase, Beth,
zh: 不,其实有点像你的手提箱,贝丝,
zh_hant: 不,其實有點像你的手提箱,貝絲,

text: it ended up,
it ended up being OK because the person
who took my job then decided that he didn't want
zh: 是谁接了我的工作,然后又不想干了
zh_hant: 是誰接了我的工作,然後又不想幹了

text: the job either.
So in the end, I did stay.
So when we make mistakes , Neil,
sometimes we then have a regret
zh: 有时我们随后会感到后悔
zh_hant: 有時我們隨後會感到後悔

text: or we regret the thing that we did.
zh: 要么我们后悔自己做过的事。
zh_hant: 要麼我們後悔自己做過的事。

text: That means that we feel bad about it.
zh: 这意味着我们对此感到内疚。
zh_hant: 這意味著我們對此感到內疚。

text: Or we wish that we'd done something differently.
zh: 我们希望自己当初做了不同的选择。
zh_hant: 我們希望自己當初做了不同的選擇。

text: Do you have any regrets ?
Yeah.
When I was a kid,
I guess I was probably 12 or 13,
I had some piano lessons,
and I quit as soon
as I could.
My parents gave me that choice.
zh: 我父母给了我那个选择的权利。
zh_hant: 我父母給了我那個選擇的權利。

text: And I regret that because I love music and I play guitar,
zh: 我很后悔,因为我热爱音乐,还会弹吉他。
zh_hant: 我很後悔,因為我熱愛音樂,還會彈吉他。

text: and I think I would have enjoyed playing piano.
zh: 我觉得我本来会喜欢弹钢琴的。
zh_hant: 我覺得我本來會喜歡彈鋼琴的。

text: I always think, to be honest,
zh: 老实说,我一直都这么认为,
zh_hant: 老實說,我一直都這麼認為,

text: you shouldn't have any regrets ,
because whatever you've done, you've learnt something from it.
zh: 因为无论你做了什么,你都能从中学到一些东西。
zh_hant: 因為無論你做了什麼,你都能從中學到一些東西。

text: Even if something bad happened,
zh: 即使发生了不好的事情,
zh_hant: 即使發生了不好的事情,

text: then you know for next time.
And it's a kind of self-improvement thing.
zh: 这是一种自我提升的方式。
zh_hant: 這是一種自我提升的方式。

text: That is a very positive attitude to mistakes , Beth.
zh: Beth,对待错误能有这种积极的态度非常好。
zh_hant: Beth,對待錯誤能有這種積極的態度非常好。

text: Yeah, I think it's important to learn
zh: 我觉得学习这个很重要
zh_hant: 我覺得學習這個很重要

text: from your mistakes .
zh: 从你的错误中吸取教训。
zh_hant: 從你的錯誤中吸取教訓。

text: And that's a common expression
in English, to learn from your mistakes
Let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt in this podcast.
zh: 在这期播客中,我们来复习一下学过的词汇。
zh_hant: 在這期播客中,我們來複習一下學過的詞彙。

text: Starting with mistake .
And a mistake is an action that is wrong
zh: 犯错就是做了不该做的事
zh_hant: 犯錯就是做了不該做的事

text: or that you do when you don't mean to.
And we can make a mistake .
That means we do something wrong.
zh: 这说明我们做错了什么。
zh_hant: 這說明我們做錯了什麼。

text: Or we can do something by mistake ,
zh: 我们也可能不小心做错某事。
zh_hant: 我們也可能不小心做錯某事。

text: which means we do something accidentally without meaning to.
zh: 这意味着我们无意中做了某事,并非故意的。
zh_hant: 這意味著我們無意中做了某事,並非故意的。

text: For example, I left my suitcase on the train
zh: 比如说,我把行李箱落在火车上了。
zh_hant: 比如說,我把行李箱落在火車上了。

text: by mistake .
We also heard regret ,
zh: 我们也听到了遗憾之情。
zh_hant: 我們也聽到了遺憾之情。

text: which means feel bad or sorry
zh: 意思是感到难过或抱歉
zh_hant: 意思是感到難過或抱歉

text: about something you've done or a mistake that you've made.
zh: 关于你做过的某件事或犯过的某个错误。
zh_hant: 關於你做過的某件事或犯過的某個錯誤。

text: And we heard learn from your mistakes ,
zh: 我们听说过“从错误中学习”这句话
zh_hant: 我們聽說過“從錯誤中學習”這句話

text: which means remember the mistake
zh: 这意味着要记住这个错误
zh_hant: 這意味著要記住這個錯誤

text: and then not do it again the next time.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: You can test yourself on what you've learned with a worksheet on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们网站上通过一份练习题来检验自己所学的内容。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們網站上透過一份練習題來檢驗自己所學的內容。

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Next week we'll be talking about trains, buses and public transport.
zh: 下周我们要谈谈火车、公交车和公共交通。
zh_hant: 下週我們要談談火車、公交車和公共交通。

text: See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
